title: Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets
abstract: arXiv:2610.33968v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are trained to sample objects from compositional spaces with probability proportional to a reward function, but ineffective exploration can cause learned samplers to concentrate on a few high-reward regions. An intuitive remedy is to train multiple GFlowNets independently in parallel and combine their samples. However, this does not prevent multiple models from collapsing onto the same high-reward areas, leaving large regions of the state space unexplored. With this in mind, we propose Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets (HCG), an approach that dynamically partitions the search space to coordinate discovery without relying on hand-crafted boundaries. HCG imposes an ordering in which the highest-ranked model may explore the entire space, while lower-ranked models are progressively pushed toward regions not covered by higher-ranked ones. translated_abstract: 生成流网络被训练用于从组合空间中按与奖励函数成正比的概率采样对象，但低效的探索可能导致学习到的采样器集中在少数高奖励区域。一个直观的补救方法是并行独立地训练多个 GFlowNets 并合并它们的样本。然而，这并不能阻止多个模型坍缩到相同的高奖励区域，使状态空间的大片区域未被探索。考虑到这一点，我们提出了层次协同 GFlowNets（HCG），一种无需依赖手工设计边界、通过动态划分搜索空间来协调发现的方法。HCG 施加了一种排序机制：排名最高的模型可以探索整个空间，而排名较低的模型则被逐步推向未被更高排名模型覆盖的区域。我们对特定学习机制如何（对所提方法进行理论刻画，原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出层次协同 GFlowNets（HCG），通过对多个模型施加排名并动态划分搜索空间，使低排名模型探索高排名模型未覆盖的区域，从而避免多个模型坍缩到相同的高奖励区域、提升探索多样性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets (HCG), which dynamically partitions the search space by ranking models so that lower-ranked ones explore regions not covered by higher-ranked ones, preventing multiple GFlowNets from collapsing onto the same high-reward areas.
